It's like, they're not really present in the moment. And that's not just limited to younger people, either. I've seen adults doing the same thing.

Now, on the other hand, I think there are some really smart people out there who are using technology to learn and grow in amazing ways. I've seen some of the documentaries on Netflix, and the things people are doing with AI and machine learning are just incredible. So, I don't think we're getting dumber, per se. I just think we need to be more mindful of how we're using technology and make sure we're not losing touch with the world around us.

And I think that's where education comes in. We need to be teaching people how to use technology in a way that's healthy and productive, not just how to use it to scroll through their phones all day. We need to be teaching critical thinking and problem-solving skills, so people can navigate the world in a more thoughtful way. That's just my two cents, but I think it's an important conversation to have.
